thag10.2:1.1:
If, in front or behind,
there is no one else,
thag10.2:1.4:
for one staying alone
in the forest.
thag10.2:2.1:
Come then! Alone
I will go
thag10.2:2.2:
to the wilderness
praised by the Awakened One
thag10.2:3.4:
the haunt
of elephants in rut.
thag10.2:4.1: When the Cool Forest’s in full flower,
thag10.2:6.1:
As I desire to do this,
may my purpose succeed.
thag10.2:6.3:
I myself
will bring it about.
thag10.2:6.4:
No one can do it
for anyone else.
thag10.2:7.1:
I myself
bind on my armor.
thag10.2:7.4:
without having attained
the end of the effluents.
thag10.2:8.4: as I sit on a mountaintop.
thag10.2:9.1: In the forest covered with blossoms
thag10.2:9.2: or perhaps on a cool hillside,
thag10.2:9.3: blessed with the bliss of release,
thag10.2:10.1:
I am now he
whose resolves are fulfilled
thag10.2:10.2: like the moon on a full-moon night.
thag10.2:10.4: there is now no further becoming.
